hello.label: Hello / Namaste
hello.description: Press both palms together near chest in traditional Namaste gesture.

namaste.label: Namaste
namaste.description: Press both palms together near chest with a slight head bow.

thank you.label: Thank You
thank you.description: Touch both hands to chin and open palms forward toward person.

thanks.label: Thanks
thanks.description: Touch both hands to chin and open palms forward toward person.

yes.label: Yes
yes.description: Form a fist and move hand up and down firmly twice.

no.label: No
no.description: Wave open flat hand side to side horizontally in front of chest.

help.label: Help
help.description: Place right fist onto left flat palm and raise both upwards.

water.label: Water
water.description: Form cup with hand and bring toward mouth as if drinking.

food.label: Food
food.description: Gather all fingertips together and touch to mouth twice.

eat.label: Eat
eat.description: Gather all fingertips together and touch to mouth twice.

please.label: Please
please.description: Place flat open right hand on heart and move in gentle circle.

sorry.label: Sorry
sorry.description: Place fist over center chest and move in gentle circular motion.

friend.label: Friend
friend.description: Clasp both hands together firmly as a handshake.

my name is.label: My Name Is
my name is.description: Point to chest, then tap middle fingers of both hands together.

good morning.label: Good Morning
good morning.description: Thumbs up (GOOD) followed by sweeping sun arc up from horizon (MORNING).

stop.label: Stop
stop.description: Hold both open palms straight forward toward person.

deaf.label: Deaf
deaf.description: Point index finger to ear then place flat palm over mouth.

peace.label: Peace
peace.description: Cross wrists in front of chest then open out smoothly.
